current_activity: Navy SBDs from Henderson Field attack a Japanese supply convoy off Tassafaronga
notes: Cressman, 15 October 1942: planes from Henderson Field, including Navy and Marine SBDs (VMSB 141, VB 6, and other unidentified units) and Navy F4Fs (VF 5), attack a Japanese supply convoy off Tassafaronga. Cressman also names VB 6 from Henderson on 16 October. Confidence 0.5 (single us_navy_nhhc family). Branch guadalcanal-carrier-air-missions, 26 November 2026.
